text_block_list.text:
One day, passing by the dorms,
lively voices could be heard.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Come on! Just call it a win for Ritto!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: No way! Miho caught plenty too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My my, pony-chans gathered up.
...What's the commotion?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, won't stand for fights!
Let me in on it!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Dorm Leader! Been waiting for you!
Ritto vs Miho cops and robbers match!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Cops and robbers! Police team chasing thieves,
how nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: But we can't settle it~.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Dorm leaders 1v1,
settle it once and for all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh--?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hear '1v1', can't back down!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh, fun.
You and me—showdown, Hishi Ama!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Fuji-senpai is the thief! Escape to win~!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Ama-senpai is the cop!
Wrap arms around and hug to capture!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Catch me if you can, Hishi Ama!
If your hands can reach this two-stage rocket!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ha, you'll be crying soon!
'Empress' name ain't for show!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Man, gave me a hard time.
Finally cornered ya.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: —Give up, Fuji.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hate losing... but caught by you is no regret.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
——What!?
Why're you smiling!?

Fuji Kiseki pulled Hishi Amazon's waist close
with practiced motion, embracing her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wha—hey! What're you thinking!?
L-Let goooooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Came to steal you.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaa!!

Winner undecided, both dorms closed
out in huge excitement...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Geez, don't mess with Big Sis Hishi Ama!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indulged myself because it was you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hey—Hishi Ama. As dorm leader,
want everyone to have best time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Tch, show-off.

Swearing aside, faint smile formed
on Hishi Amazon's lips.
